_note: This week's primetime DraftKings NFL Showdown GPPs (public DraftKings lobby + contest detail), ranked by dupe-adjusted top-1% equity per $1. Built by codex/contest_economics.py --this-week. Not advice to enter any contest.

method.included: guaranteed tournaments with 100+ max entries on primetime showdown draft groups; excluded: double-ups, 50/50s, multipliers/boosters, qualifiers, satellites, must-fill and N-player contests, leagues
method.field_size: the contest's maximum entries (primetime GPPs fill or nearly fill); entries_now = entries at pull time
method.top1_equity: prizes paid to the top 1% of places / (fee x field size) = $ back per $1 from top-1% finishes at a 1% rate
method.dupe_haircut: from contest_economics.json: what top-1% finishes paid after splitting with duplicate lineups, as a share of face value, for the same field-size x entry-max cell (field-size, then entry-max marginal when that cell has < 3 contests)
method.dupe_adj_top1_equity: top1_equity x dupe_haircut — the ranking key (contests without a haircut rank on half their raw equity)
method.dupe_risk: historical mean number of other identical entries per top-1% entry in the same cell: high >= 25, medium >= 5, low < 5; winner_split_pct = share of those contests whose 1st place was a duplicated lineup
